$comment: BS.1770 is the measurement algorithm every loudness standard here is measured with, and it is NOT a delivery standard: its Scope is 'audio measurement algorithms for the purpose of determining subjective programme loudness, and true-peak signal level', and none of its five recommends clauses states a target, a tolerance or a peak ceiling. It is defined here so that naming it is recognised rather than unknown — and so a spec naming BS.1770 alongside its own numbers is read correctly: the numbers are the spec's, and BS.1770 is how they are measured.
name: ITU-R BS.1770
